# API Design Prompts

Contracts and compatibility — stops breaking changes to endpoints consumers you can't see depend on.

**32 prompts.** Install the whole category bundle:

```
Please fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bentheautomator/free_ai_prompts_that_dont_suck/main/install/api-design.md and append its contents to my project instructions file.
```

| Prompt | Severity | What It Solves | Install |
|--------|----------|----------------|---------|
| [Freeze API ID Formats](freeze-api-id-formats.md) | critical | Stops int-to-UUID and number-to-string ID changes that break stored references | [install](../../install/freeze-api-id-formats.md) |
| [Freeze API Timestamp Formats](freeze-api-timestamp-formats.md) | critical | Stops epoch-to-ISO timestamp changes that break every date parser downstream | [install](../../install/freeze-api-timestamp-formats.md) |
